name: gallery
description: MERN gallery application for browsing network/local media directories

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.electron:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development concurrently "npm run client" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron ." --names "CLIENT,ELECTRON" --prefix-colors "magenta,yellow"
scripts.electron:build: npm run build && cross-env NODE_ENV=production electron-builder
